### `GetFilePathDisplayMode`

Returns how filepaths\index{file paths!display in batch projects} are displayed in batch projects.

#### Syntax {-}

``` {.lua}
FilePathDisplayMode GetFilePathDisplayMode()
```

#### Return value {-}

Type: [`FilePathDisplayMode`](#filepathdisplaymode)

How filepaths are displayed in lists.
:::
